items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I know him when he first came here from New Orleans.

ctx.x: I'm working on some material now on Jolly Roll Morton, who was one of my favorite pianists, and of course he wrote a lot of pieces, and I just figured that anyone in the business, as long as you would have known him...
I know him when he first came here from New Orleans. I was working at the Monaco in... Yes, it was.
